title: Technical Disagreement & Cross-Functional Conflict Resolution
description: Demonstrate leadership, communication, and pragmatic technical trade-off negotiation using the STAR framework (Situation, Task, Action, Result).

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: In your experience note {experience_id}, you described a conflict regarding {topic}. What was the specific business stakes or technical deadline at risk?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Establishes authentic context without generic or embellished employer background.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: What was your direct responsibility versus the team's responsibility in resolving {topic}?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Distinguishes candidate's specific ownership from collective group effort.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: What concrete technical steps or communication channels did you personally lead to de-escalate the debate?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Candidate must focus on 'I did' actions, prototyping, or data-driven benchmarking rather than 'we just agreed'.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: What was the final outcome, and what concrete metrics or team outcomes resulted?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: If metrics were not formally tracked, candidate must state impact honestly rather than fabricating percentages.

probing_guidelines.prompt_template: Looking back, what trade-off would you make differently next time?
probing_guidelines.evidence_check: Shows introspection and growth without defensive justifications.

behavioral.star.missing_personal_action.title: STAR Framework: Personal Action Articulation
behavioral.star.missing_personal_action.description: Structure narrative around 'I' contributions, prototyping data points, and facilitating consensus.

behavioral.star.fabricated_metrics.title: Honest Impact & Qualitative Result Articulation
behavioral.star.fabricated_metrics.description: Learn to frame qualitative outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and risk reduction when numeric metrics were not measured.
